# Facts dossier: 4-sulfamoylanilinium dihydrogen phosphate (SAPH)

Every number the main text and the SI may print, with its unit, the precision to print, its source (file + JSON key or log line) and what it means. Same content as `facts.json` (flat key → {value, unit, precision, case, source, meaning, note, status, rederived, agrees}). Generated by `paper/main/data/build_facts.py` from the result files and from the independent re-derivations in `derive/d01–d15` (outputs in `derived/`). Regenerate:

    P=/root/workspace/cqc-dft/tools/paper-env/bin/python; cd paper/main/data/derive
    for s in d01_xray d03_geometry d04_scan d05_freq d06_electronic d07_hirshfeld d08_periodic d09_dock d10_rep_contacts d11_burst2 d12_revision d13_referee_calcs d14_completion d15_control; do nice $P $s.py; done
    nice /root/cqc-sfa-tools/env/bin/python d02_models.py   # PySCF basis counts
    cd ../../../.. && nice $P paper/main/data/build_facts.py && nice $P paper/main/data/build_tables.py

**11111 facts (6648 itemised below, 4463 bulk SI-table values in section 21); 3556 independently re-derived, 3556 agree, 0 disagree.** Column "check": ✓ = re-derived by our own script and equal within the printed precision; ✗ = disagreement (listed below); blank = read from the source only. Model names: ion pair (27 atoms, anion at x, y, z − 1), gas phase, IEF-PCM (water), IEF-PCM (ε = n), periodic model. Level: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311++G(d,p) unless stated.

**Rounding rule**: Printed value = full-precision value rounded half to even at the fact precision. Stored values that are themselves rounded ties are replaced by the full-precision re-derivation from the same raw data (stored_value and note keep the original); tables (build_tables.py f) and figure texts (_saph.num) format with the same rule.

**Withdrawn facts**: the relax_iifix energies and structure metrics (keys containing "iifix", except the three slide diagnostics kept for a methodological note) are kept for provenance with a null value and the number struck through below; they are not cited (section 30).

**Superseded facts** (section 36): the rigid DFT strain of the docked poses and the order-of-magnitude checks on the constrained configuration are retired (value null, the number struck through below); the relax_iirfix energies stay citable only as the constrained single configuration (O5–H1A held at 0.98 Å), not as the periodic cost.

## Notes on the values

- The first constrained-neutral periodic structure (relax_iifix, burst 2, H1A alone held in space, +3.9 kJ/mol per formula unit) is withdrawn. Its optimiser translated every other atom by ~0.66 Å (floating origin of Pc) until N1 re-bonded to H1A (final N1–H1A 1.068 Å, H1A···O5 1.660 Å, δ = −0.592 Å, proton on N1), so the +3.87 kJ/mol (80.2 meV/cell) compares two salt structures. The iifix facts are kept for provenance with value null and status WITHDRAWN (their numbers sit in withdrawn_value, where numbers_audit cannot match them) and are not cited. The constrained configuration with the proton on O5 is relax_iirfix (H1A and O5 both held, O5–H1A 0.98 Å, no slide): +57.1 kJ/mol per formula unit at PBE-D3(BJ), +52.8 with the PBE0-D3(BJ) correction (section 28). iifix appears only in a methodological note: O5 has to be held as well.
- The automatic draft report of the pipeline (molecules/sfa/results/sfa_pair_pcm_d3/RESULTS.md, written by dft/report.py; not part of the paper) gives "integration grid level 3" and no Multiwfn version; the runs used grid level 4 (scan_summary.json level.grid_level, every provenance block, the opt.xyz comment "grid 4") and Multiwfn 2026.9.20, as the paper and SI Table S1 state.
- The same draft gives the zero-point energy of the pair as 5.299 eV (0.19472 Ha = 122.19 kcal/mol), which the paper does not use, and a Koopmans-type "IP/EA/χ/η/ω" table, while dscf.json gives the ΔSCF values (I 7.488 vs 7.642 eV; A 1.857 vs 1.666 eV; η 2.816 vs 2.988 eV). The paper gives the ΔSCF values, with the Koopmans-type values as the comparison.
- Barrier: the B3LYP-D3 electronic barrier on the scan grid is 0.72 kcal/mol (0.75 by spline; 1-D DVR ground level 0.66 kcal/mol above the salt). The paper gives 0.72 kcal/mol.
- Functional check: every method puts the neutral end point below the salt end point (ωB97X-D −0.72, PBE0-D3 −1.27, DF-MP2 −1.42, M06-2X −2.47 kcal/mol; B3LYP-D3 −0.54), but PBE0-D3 and M06-2X also put the d = 1.25 Å point below the salt (no barrier on this path), and DF-MP2 puts it only +0.20 kcal/mol above; the salt minimum is a shallow feature of B3LYP-D3, ωB97X-D and DF-MP2 at these geometries, below the N–H zero-point energy in every case.
- Dielectric ladder: the proton ends on O5 at ε = 1 and 4 (δ +0.675 Å at ε = 4) and on N1 at ε = 8, 20 and 78.4; a salt minimum first appears between ε = 4 and 8 (one start per ε: this brackets where the minimum appears, not a thermodynamic crossover).
- ADCH, CM5 and Hirshfeld charges are used for the fragment charge transfer; the ADCH atomic charges on C3/C6/H3/H6 are sign-inverted (unphysical) in the PCM pair.
- 3HS4 cross-dock from the DFT geometry: the RMSD to 6RL9 sulfanilamide carried into 3HS4 is 3.2150 Å at full precision (derive/d09_dock.py, 20 poses; per-seed values rounded to 3 decimals also average exactly 3.2150) and prints as 3.22 ± 0.02 Å; production_summary.json stores 3.215, which a binary float rounds down to 3.21. The paper (Figure 8b, Table 6), the SI, dock/RESULTS.md and dock/VALIDATION.md print 3.22 ± 0.02 Å (fact dock.prod.3HS4.sfa.ad4zn.rmsd).
- Rounding ties (rule: round half to even on the full-precision value; a stored value that is itself a tie is replaced by the full-precision re-derivation from the same raw data, the stored value kept in the note): xray.P1-O6 stored 1.4975 (printed 1.498) → full precision 1.497510, prints 1.498; proton.gas.C1N1 stored 1.4165 (printed 1.417) → full precision 1.416451, prints 1.416; proton.scanN.d_N1_H1A stored 1.0985 (printed 1.099) → full precision 1.098458, prints 1.098; proton.scanO.d_N1_H1A stored 1.6305 (printed 1.631) → full precision 1.630541, prints 1.631; scan.A00.d_NH stored 1.0985 (printed 1.099) → full precision 1.098458, prints 1.098; scan.B00.d_NH stored 1.6305 (printed 1.631) → full precision 1.630541, prints 1.631; dock.val.T5_7S2K.dhp_anion__vina.rmsd_sd stored 0.025 (printed 0.03) → full precision 0.025166, prints 0.03; dock.val.T1_3TZF.smx_anion__vina.rmsd_sd stored 0.045 (printed 0.04) → full precision 0.044797, prints 0.04; dock.prod.3TZF.azm_anion.vinardo.score stored -4.45 (printed −4.5) → full precision -4.449800, prints −4.4; dock.prod.3TZF.paba_anion.vina.sd stored 0.015 (printed 0.01) → full precision 0.015019, prints 0.02; dock.prod.6RL9.azm_neutral.vina.sd stored 0.025 (printed 0.03) → full precision 0.025150, prints 0.03; dock.prod.6RL9.paba_anion.vina.sd stored 0.005 (printed 0.01) → full precision 0.004643, prints 0.00; dock.prod.7S2K.azm_neutral.vinardo.sd stored 0.035 (printed 0.04) → full precision 0.034765, prints 0.03; dock.prod.7S2K.sfa_anion.vina.sd stored 0.015 (printed 0.01) → full precision 0.015206, prints 0.02; dock.prod.7S2K.smx_neutral.vina.sd stored 0.035 (printed 0.04) → full precision 0.035204, prints 0.04; periodic.hybrid.e100.PBE0_meV stored 1077.35 (printed 1077.3) → full precision 1077.352242, prints 1077.4. xray.P1-O6 is re-derived from the full-precision .res coordinates (1.497510 Å): the earlier 1.497493 came from the _atom_site coordinates rounded to their s.u., so 1.498 (as in the CIF, 1.4975(14)) stands.
- SCF convergence as run: IEF-PCM optimisations, scans, the dielectric ladder and the torsion scans used 10⁻⁸ Ha (dft/optimize.py, dft/proton_tools.py), gas-phase optimisations, the functional check, ΔSCF and TD-DFT 10⁻⁹ Ha, and the final single points (orbitals, Hessians, NLO, interaction energies) 10⁻¹⁰ Ha. Table S1 and Section 2.2 give these thresholds.
- The single constrained configuration (relax_iirfix) overstates the periodic cost (VM burst 3). With d(N1–H1A) held and O5–H1A free, the profile at the same N1–H1A distance (1.616 Å) lies 10.4 kJ/mol per formula unit below it (Hermite interpolation of the 1.55 and 1.70 Å points). The sign is the same: the energy rises at every profile point with PBE-D3(BJ) and with PBE0-D3(BJ), every constraint force points back to N1, and a transfer in one formula unit alone relaxes back to the salt.

## Caveats of the values

- Plain B3LYP (no D3) breaks the second leg of the R²₂(8) ring: C6···O4 opens from 3.383 Å (D3) to 4.798 Å, while N1···O5 and δ are unchanged (2.584 Å, −0.387 Å). Dispersion holds the ring closed; the proton position does not depend on it.
- The whole-pair heavy-atom RMSD after superposition (0.54 Å in IEF-PCM) is dominated by the anion rotating about the N1–H1A···O5 axis; each ion alone fits to 0.12 Å (cation) and 0.04 Å (anion).
- Dielectric ladder: every ε > 1 point started from the water optimum with the proton on N1; ε = 1 is the gas optimisation from the X-ray structure. At ε = 4 the proton moved to O5 (80 steps). Only the side of the proton is compared across ε; total energies at different ε are not comparable.
- The barrier top (A_02, d = 1.25 Å) stopped at the step limit (61 steps) without the convergence flag; its constrained-projected gradient (max 1.6e-4, rms 7.6e-5 Ha/Bohr) is below the thresholds and the last step lowered E by 0.0008 kcal/mol; the 0.72 kcal/mol barrier is therefore reliable to ~0.01 kcal/mol at this grid, but it is a discrete maximum on a 0.10 Å grid (spline 0.75 kcal/mol).
- Hysteresis: the chains overlap only at d = 1.35 Å; there chain A lies 0.014 kcal/mol above chain B with the same N1···O5 to 2e-4 Å, i.e. no path dependence at this resolution. Chain A at 1.35 Å is therefore off the lower envelope.
- Functional check (five methods, fsp_scan.json): every method puts the neutral O5-protonated end point below the salt end point (B3LYP-D3 −0.54, ωB97X-D −0.72, PBE0-D3 −1.27, DF-MP2 −1.42, M06-2X −2.47 kcal/mol). The 1.25 Å point lies +0.72 (B3LYP-D3), +0.98 (ωB97X-D) and +0.20 (DF-MP2) kcal/mol above the salt but −0.05 (PBE0-D3) and −0.51 (M06-2X) below it, so the barrier is small or absent depending on the method, and always below the N–H zero-point energy (3.13 kcal/mol). These are single points at B3LYP-D3 geometries, not re-optimised, so the "barrier" of a method is its energy at one fixed geometry, not its saddle point. DF-MP2 includes the continuum only through the RHF reaction field (no correlation response of the solvent).
- ZPE vs barrier: harmonic ½hν of one normal mode (3.13 kcal/mol) against an electronic, B3LYP-D3, 1-D relaxed-scan barrier (0.72); the O-side minimum has had its own Hessian since VM burst 3 (section 33 gives the harmonic Δ(E + ZPE) of the two minima); the 1-D comparison of ½hν with the barrier is unchanged.
- The 2190 cm⁻¹ N1–H1A stretch is a harmonic value for a very short, anharmonic N⁺–H···O⁻ bond (N1···O5 2.581 Å in IEF-PCM, 2.760 Å in the crystal); a scaled harmonic number is not a prediction of the observed band, which in the crystal would be broad and at higher wavenumber (longer N···O). The O–H stretches at ~3800 cm⁻¹ are of free O–H groups in the ion pair: in the crystal both O–H donate strong H-bonds (O4–H4A···O5 2.500 Å), so these bands do not describe the solid.
- TD-DFT: with B3LYP four of the first five ion-pair states are anion→cation CT (CT number 0.61–0.91, D_CT 3.3–5.0 Å); with CAM-B3LYP none is (CT ≤ 0.04). The first strong CAM-B3LYP band of the pair (S2, 211 nm, f = 0.18) sits at the cation value (208 nm) — the pair spectrum is the cation spectrum. The released neutral sulfanilamide absorbs at 246 nm (S2, 246.45 nm, f = 0.50, non-equilibrium; 256 nm equilibrium). Section 3.5 of the main text quotes two measured values beside the computed bands: the wavelength at which aqueous sulfanilamide is determined (258 nm) and the reported UV–Vis cut-off of SAPH (223 nm); no spectrum is compared in detail.
- NLO: the IEF-PCM pair against gas-phase urea mixes environments (ratio 4.5); the like-for-like gas-phase ratio at the same geometry is 6.4. Static, electronic, single ion pair: no local-field factors, no crystal packing; Pc has no inversion centre, so SHG is symmetry-allowed, but a molecular β is not a crystal χ(2).
- QTAIM/IGMH exist only for the 27-atom ion pair (two contacts: N1–H1A···O5 and C6–H6···O4; in the gas phase the transferred O5–H1A···N1, N1–H1B···O4 and C6–H6···O4). The strongest crystal contact between anions, O4–H4A···O5 (2.500 Å), and the other six crystal H-bonds have BCP data only from the five-pair gas-phase cluster of section 34 (M8, VM burst 3).
- ADCH atomic charges in the IEF-PCM pair are unphysical on the ring C–H pairs (C6 +0.78, C3 +0.52 with H6 −0.22, H3 −0.20 e); the paper uses NPA/CM5 atom values and ADCH only as fragment sums.
- Hirshfeld: our surface agrees with Multiwfn on area (0.01 %/1.2 %) and contact percentages (≤ 0.1 point), but the d_norm minima differ (cation −0.721 vs −0.383; anion −0.842 vs −0.446) because the Multiwfn d_norm does not follow the CrystalExplorer formula with Bondi radii (same cluster, same normalised X–H; d_i and d_e agree to ~0.01 Å; dft/hirshfeld.py docstring). The paper gives our d_norm (CrystalExplorer definition) and says so.
- Condensed Fukui functions (section 24) are vertical finite differences in IEF-PCM (water) with each charge state solvated at equilibrium, at the neutral (or cation) optimum; they describe the isolated, solvated species, not the crystal. NPA and Hirshfeld give the same ordering of the leading sites but different magnitudes (Hirshfeld flattens them); a few condensed values are slightly negative (NPA f− on C3, C5 and S1 of sulfanilamide), a known artefact of condensing finite differences, not a physical negative reactivity.
- ADMET (section 25): sulfanilamide is in the training data of 26 of the 41 ADMET-AI endpoints, so agreement there (solubility, LD50, AMES, DILI, CYP inhibition) is recall, not validation. Where it is not (plasma protein binding, half-life, bioavailability, lipophilicity), the model can be tested: PPBR 54 % predicted against about 22 % bound (Davis 1943, human plasma, dialysis at refrigerator temperature). Crippen cLogP (−0.08) is 0.5 above the measured log P (−0.62). The predicted half-life (16.3 h) is longer than the about 10 h derived from urinary excretion in man (Koizumi 1964, Nogami 1968; t½ = ln 2/k is our conversion).
- Periodic constrained neutral (relax_iirfix): a constrained structure, not a minimum. With O5–H1A held at 0.98 Å the rest of the cell relaxes (free-atom forces below 5e-4 Ry/Bohr) while the held H1A carries 0.103 Ry/Bohr (2.6 eV/Å) pointing to N1, so the proton would return to N1. +57.1 (PBE-D3(BJ)) and +52.8 kJ/mol per formula unit (with the PBE0-D3(BJ) correction, −4.3) are the cost of holding the proton on O5 at a normal O–H length in this lattice; the value depends on the chosen O5–H1A (no periodic scan of it was run). The hybrid correction is evaluated at PBE-D3(BJ) geometries, with SG15 potentials (not the SSSP set of the relaxations; the PBE difference itself changes by −0.8 kJ/mol per formula unit between the two sets) and a 2×1×1 k grid; cutoff (80/100 Ry) and q mesh (1×1×1/2×1×1) move the correction by 0.46 kJ/mol. The correction is 97 % exact exchange (−87.4 of −90.0 meV/cell) and 3 % the change of D3(BJ) parameters.
- Section 31: the co-crystal torsions are those of the ligand copy used as the docking reference (6RL9 SAN 304, zinc-bound; the two further SAN copies of 6RL9 lie in secondary sites); the ΔΔ scores and zinc-filtered ranks are orders of empirical scores, well inside the scoring error of the functions; the O–H relief and stress estimates are order-of-magnitude checks with stated assumptions, not calculations; the strain against the same-H reference is still rigid (no constrained relaxation), so it bounds the torsional strain from above.
- Periodic profile (section 32): a constrained path in the fixed X-ray cell, with d(N1–H1A) of both formula units held together (the per-cell energy moves two protons). Converged on the constrained forces below 10⁻³ Ry/Bohr, twice the threshold of the unconstrained relaxations. The PBE0-D3(BJ) values are single points at the PBE-D3(BJ) geometries (no hybrid relaxation), so the PBE0 curve shows the functional dependence of the energies, not of the path. The 1.70 Å point is not a minimum either: its constraint force still points to N1. No cell-relaxed end point was computed: the residual pressures (−4.4 kbar salt, +2.4 kbar at 1.70 Å) give only an order-of-magnitude stress term, −1.1 kJ/mol per formula unit for B = 10 GPa, which would raise the cost. The single-transfer control is one unconstrained start at PBE-D3(BJ).
- Neutral IEF-PCM minimum (section 33): Δ(E + ZPE), ΔH and ΔG are harmonic RRHO numbers on a continuum solute, with every mode down to 17.7 cm⁻¹ treated as a harmonic vibration; they sharpen the electronic ordering (the salt has the larger ZPE) but carry the continuum error of section 31 (the separated-species exchange is 5.6 kcal/mol off the measured ΔpKa). The proton stretches (2190 and 2567 cm⁻¹) are harmonic values of strongly anharmonic modes.
- Cluster QTAIM (section 34): a finite, gas-phase cluster of five ion pairs at the periodic geometries, a double-zeta basis and no embedding. Its descriptors show how each of the nine bonds responds when H1A sits on O5 (ρ at N1–H1B···O6, N1–H1C···O6 and O4–H4A···O5 falls by 34, 29 and 24 %); its energy does not describe the crystal. The salt cluster has a HOMO–LUMO gap of only 1.15 eV and prefers the neutral arrangement by 54.0 kJ/mol per ion pair, the opposite sign to the periodic cell (+57.1 kJ/mol for the same constrained configuration at PBE-D3(BJ)): the under-coordinated surface ions of a finite cluster in vacuum favour neutral partners, so the local hydrogen-bond network alone, without the rest of the ionic lattice, does not hold the proton. The O5-protonated cluster uses the constrained single configuration (O5–H1A held at 0.98 Å), not the profile.
- Relaxed torsion scans (section 35): electronic energies in IEF-PCM of the free ligand, one-dimensional in C3–C4–S1–N2 (the N–H rotors and the C4–S1–N2 angle relax at each point). They replace the rigid single points of sections 29 and 31. The sulfonamidate minimum re-optimised at 101.6° is not the lowest point of its own scan: the profile is flat to within 0.1 kcal/mol, its lowest point at 170° (−0.09). Strain values between computed points are spline interpolations (checked against exact points to 0.023 kcal/mol).
- Superseded (section 36): the rigid DFT strain of the docked poses (sections 29, 31) is retired; the relax_iirfix numbers (+57.1 PBE-D3(BJ), +52.8 kJ/mol PBE0-D3(BJ)) are the energy of one constrained single configuration with O5–H1A held at 0.98 Å, 10.4 kJ/mol per formula unit above the relaxed profile at the same N1–H1A distance; the periodic cost is now the profile of section 32 (+51.6 PBE-D3(BJ), +50.0 kJ/mol PBE0-D3(BJ) at 1.70 Å, rising at every point).

## Not computed (stated limitations)

- Frequencies: the IEF-PCM ion pair (salt and neutral minima), the gas-phase sulfanilamide, cation (gas/PCM), H2PO4− (gas/PCM), H3PO4 (gas) and urea have Hessians. No frequencies for the gas-phase pair, the plain-B3LYP and def2-TZVP pairs, H3PO4 (PCM), and sulfanilamide (PCM) and the sulfonamidate (PCM): they are stationary points on the force criterion only (SI Section S2).
- No ΔSCF for the sulfonamidate, H2PO4− or the gas-phase pair. Condensed Fukui functions exist for sulfanilamide and the cation in IEF-PCM (section 24), not for the ion pair, the sulfonamidate or the gas phase.
- Periodic profile (section 32): no cell-relaxed end point (vc-relax) and no hybrid relaxation; the PBE0-D3(BJ) curve is single points at PBE-D3(BJ) geometries. Stated as a limitation in Section 4.3 of the main text.
- No molecular calibration of the PBE-to-PBE0 shift (PBE-D3(BJ) single points on the three IEF-PCM scan geometries): stated as a limitation in Section 4.3.
- Continuum: no PCM Hessians of sulfanilamide and H3PO4, no SMD or radius-scaling single points and no larger-basis single points of the scan geometries were computed; the continuum error (pt.sep.continuum_error) is stated in Section 4.3, not corrected.
- No point-charge embedding of the ion pair and no cluster-continuum pair were computed; the five-pair gas-phase cluster of section 34 is analysed for its bond descriptors, and only the sign of its energy is read (a finite cluster in vacuum, not an energy control of the crystal).

## 1. Crystal structure (deposited CIF)

From e-70-0o997-sup1.cif (Acta Cryst. E 2014, 70, o997). Hydrogen bonds recomputed from _atom_site with our own code (derive/d01_xray.py): every D···A reproduces the deposited value to within 0.0006 Å; H···A and angles are checked against the full-precision coordinates of the embedded .res (the _atom_site H coordinates carry only 3 decimals). N–H hydrogens were refined freely, C–H riding (AFIX 43, 0.93 Å), O–H restrained with DFIX 0.82 Å: the O–H positions are not experimental.

## 4. Ion-pair geometries and the comparison with the X-ray structure

All bond statistics recomputed (derive/d03_geometry.py) over the 26 bonds perceived in the X-ray pair; classes as below. X–H bonds are compared for completeness only: the X-ray C–H are riding at 0.93 Å and the O–H restrained to 0.82 Å, so their deviations measure the X-ray model, not DFT. In the gas phase H1A has moved to O5, so N1–H1A is excluded there. "periodic" = relax_i of the PBE-D3(BJ) cell, formula unit 1.

## 7. Functional check at the scan end points (fsp_scan.json, five methods)

Single points on the B3LYP-D3(BJ) geometries of A_00 (salt, d = 1.098 Å), A_02 (d = 1.250 Å) and B_00 (neutral, d = 1.631 Å), IEF-PCM water, 6-311++G(d,p): B3LYP-D3(BJ), ωB97X-D, PBE0-D3(BJ), M06-2X and DF-MP2 (frozen core, aug-cc-pVTZ-RI fitting basis; PCM as a perturbation, reaction field frozen at the RHF density). Read from sfa_pair_pcm_d3/fsp_scan.json (burst 2, 28 Sep 2026, all 15 points recomputed). Re-derived (derive/d11_burst2.py): differences recomputed from each E_Ha; the three geometry files re-hashed (sha256 as recorded) and re-measured; the four DFT energies reproduce the burst-1 run, whose JSON was lost and whose log had been parsed by derive/d04_scan.py, to < 1e-10 Ha.

## 9. Vibrational frequencies, IR intensities and thermochemistry (IEF-PCM ion pair)

Finite-difference Hessian, 75 real modes, 0 imaginary. Frequencies re-derived by our own diagonalisation of the archived hessian.npy (max |Δν| 0.10 cm⁻¹ vs freq.json, average atomic masses), IR intensities from dipole_derivatives.npy (max |ΔI| 0.30 km mol⁻¹). Assignments from bond-stretch/angle-bend projections of each mode (heuristic character, not a PED). Scaled = × 0.9688, the fundamental-frequency factor of Merrick, Moran & Radom 2007 for B3-LYP/6-311+G(d,p); 6-311++G(d,p) is not in their table, and 6-311+G(d,p) is the closest basis they list (it lacks only the diffuse s shell on H). The Crossref record was checked through lit.py (not retracted), and the table row was read in the full text (Tables 2 and 6) and in two independent tabulations that agree (see freq.scale_factor). Alternatives for this level are listed as freq.scale_factor.alt_*; they span 0.959–0.969, i.e. about 1 % (≈ 35 cm⁻¹ at 3500 cm⁻¹), which is the uncertainty of any scaled wavenumber.

## 10. Frontier orbitals, DOS and reactivity descriptors

Orbital energies re-read from the archived final.molden files (derive/d06_electronic.py), identical to fmo.json. ΔSCF: I = E(N−1) − E(N), A = E(N) − E(N+1), vertical, same functional/basis/grid/PCM (equilibrium solvation of the ions); η = (I − A)/2, χ = (I + A)/2, ω = χ²/2η. Koopmans-type values use −ε(HOMO), −ε(LUMO).

## 12. Static NLO response, against urea at the same level

Recomputed from the raw finite-field dipoles in nlo.json (derive/d06_electronic.py): α and β by central differences at F = 0.001 and 0.002 a.u. with one Richardson step; β_i = ⅓Σ_j(β_ijj + β_jij + β_jji), β_tot = |β|. Convention: Taylor (T) series μ = μ0 + αF + ½βF²; β(B convention) = β(T)/2. 1 a.u. of β = 8.6392 × 10⁻³³ esu. Urea is gas phase; the like-for-like ratio uses the gas-phase pair at the IEF-PCM geometry.

## 13. Interaction energies of the ion pair

Counterpoise-corrected, recomputed from the stored fragment energies (derive/d06_electronic.py). E_int(CP) = E_AB − E_A(AB basis) − E_B(AB basis) + ΔD3; E_def = fragment in the complex minus the relaxed fragment; E_bind = E_int(CP) + ΣE_def. In PCM the counterpoise is approximate (each species in its own cavity).

## 19. Docking: production (DFT geometries of the sulfanilamide species)

dock/results/production_summary.json; 72 production jobs. Scores are docking scores in kcal mol⁻¹ (never affinities), mean ± SD over seeds; ranks by mean score among all species docked to that receptor with that scoring function, no site filter. | `dock.caveat.1` | Docking scores are empirical scores (Vina, Vinardo, AutoDock4Zn), not binding free energies; never converted to Ki/Kd; only the order against the controls is read. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.2` | Rigid receptors (one crystal conformation), ligands flexible in torsions only (bond lengths/angles fixed at the input geometry); no explicit water except the Mg coordination spheres (3 in 7S2K, 3 in 3TZF) and, in one diagnostic outside the protocol, four crystal waters of 6RL9 (section 40). No free energy is computed. The hCA II–sulfanilamide complex was simulated by molecular dynamics (section 40: nine runs of 100 ns and two sensitivity runs, with force-field terms at the sulfonamide nitrogen that failed two quantum-chemical tests); the simulations give no rate, barrier or free energy and replace no docking number. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.3` | No experimental affinity or bioassay for SAPH; validation is structural only; acetazolamide above sulfanilamide at hCA II is the only external anchor. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.4` | 1AJ0 failed validation (sulfanilamide 11.6 Å away in every seed) and is excluded from production. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.5` | 3TZF passes only the 2.0 Å criterion (SMX anion 1.92 ± 0.04 Å): 3TZF poses are qualitative, the 0.20 Å core RMSD of sulfanilamide notwithstanding. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.6` | 6RL9 AD4Zn failed the strict gate in validation (2.07 ± 1.45 Å, bimodal); with the DFT input geometry production gives 0.61 ± 0.04 Å (20/20), but the ring orientation flips with the input geometry (3HS4 cross-dock moves from 0.62 to 3.22 Å): report with the sensitivity and the validation figure, not as a passed gate. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.7` | Plain Vina/Vinardo have no metal term: no zinc-bound top pose in either hCA II receptor; their hCA II scores are a scoring-function comparison, not a binding mode. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.8` | His64 tautomer (HIE) is an assumption (≤ 0.03 kcal/mol effect with Vina; untested with AD4Zn). Species fixed at pH 7.4; the ion pair is never docked. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |
| `dock.caveat.9` | LE/FQ are size-biased (r(score, heavy atoms) = −0.87 Vina) and are not used to claim potency. |  | docking caveat to carry into the paper | `dock/RESULTS.md section 8; dock/VALIDATION.md sections 3–10` |  |

## 24. Condensed Fukui functions (IEF-PCM water; SI section S9)

Finite differences of atomic charges of the N, N−1 and N+1 electron systems at the IEF-PCM optimum of each species (vertical; N: RKS, N±1: UKS doublets; equilibrium IEF-PCM for every state), B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311++G(d,p), grid level 4, run on the Pi with 2 threads (paper/si/compute/fukui.py). f+ = q(N) − q(N+1), f− = q(N−1) − q(N), f0 = [q(N−1) − q(N+1)]/2 (Yang & Mortier 1986), with NPA charges (PySCF natural atomic orbitals of each state, as dft/mwfn_extra.py) and Hirshfeld charges (promolecule of spherically averaged neutral B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) atoms). Checks: the three total energies equal those of dscf.json (VM run, same code path; its UKS stability analysis found no instability), and the N-state NPA charges equal mwfn_extra/charges.json.

| key | value | unit | meaning | source | check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## 25. ADMET and drug-likeness sanity check (SI only; section S14)

Computed locally (no web server): RDKit 2026.03 descriptors and rule filters, and ADMET-AI 1.4.0 (Chemprop-RDKit ensembles on the TDC ADMET datasets) in /root/cqc-sfa-tools/admet (aarch64; torch 2.5.0 CPU wheel), by paper/si/compute/admet.py. The SMILES of each species was checked against the bond graph of its DFT optimum. ADMET-AI output for sulfanilamide reproduces the prediction shipped in its DrugBank reference set (DB00259) to 2e-6. Sulfanilamide itself is in the training data of 26 of the 41 ADMET-AI endpoints (AqSolDB, LD50, AMES, DILI, ClinTox, CYP inhibition and substrate sets, Tox21, skin reaction); for those a prediction is a recall of its label, not an independent test. The experimental values are read from the source named in each row; the cation rows are for reference only (it does not exist at pH 7.4 and is outside the training domain of ADMET-AI). No potency or efficacy claim is attached.

## 26. Figure rendering parameters (fig.*)

Drawing choices printed in the figure captions (isovalues, colour ranges, cut-offs, bins): figure_params.json (group B) and figure_params_groupA.json (group A) merged as fig.<name>, plus the output resolution of figkit. These are settings, not results.

| `fig.hbond_match_DA` | 0.002 | A | Fig. 1c,d: a contact is drawn as one of the nine deposited hydrogen bonds when its D...A equals the deposited value within this tolerance (and H...A within 0.02 A, angle > 120 deg) | `paper/main/figures/figure_params_groupA.json:hbond_match_DA (paper/main/figures/scripts/_crystal.py)` |  |

## 28. Periodic constrained neutral (iirfix) and the PBE0-D3(BJ) hybrid correction (burst 2)

relax_iirfix: relaxed cell (i) with H1A of both formula units moved to 0.98 Å from O5 on the N1→O5 line, then relaxed (PBE-D3(BJ), SSSP, 70/560 Ry, 2×1×1) with H1A and O5 held in space, which keeps the O5–H1A bond and pins the floating origin of Pc. A constrained structure, not a minimum. Hybrid correction: PBE0-D3(BJ) minus PBE-D3(BJ) single points at the PBE-D3(BJ) geometries with SG15 ONCV norm-conserving potentials (100/400 Ry, q mesh 1×1×1, primary; variants 80/320 Ry and q mesh 2×1×1), added to the SSSP PBE-D3(BJ) difference. Source: periodic_qe.json; every energy re-derived from the archived pw.x outputs (derive/d11_burst2.py: relax "Final energy", PBE "!" energy, PBE0 first "!" and final "!!" energies), the held atoms and final forces read from relax_iirfix.in/.out, and the single-point inputs checked to carry the relaxed coordinates (16 inputs, max deviation 1e-8 Å).

## 29. DFT strain of the docked poses (burst 2)

Single points B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311++G(d,p), IEF-PCM water, grid 4, of the representative pose of the largest cluster of each production job of the three sulfanilamide species, relative to the IEF-PCM optimum of the same species (<case>/dock_strain.json). Each pose is the DFT molecule rebuilt on the docked heavy atoms (bond lengths and angles of the optimum, torsions of the pose; dock/production_analysis.py); "Hrot" = N–H rotors of N1 and N2 re-optimised with MMFF94s at the docked heavy atoms, because the scoring functions do not score hydrogen positions; "as docked" = hydrogens where the docking left them (a sensitivity case only). Rigid single points, no constrained relaxation. Re-derived (derive/d11_burst2.py): strain recomputed from each E_Ha, every geometry re-hashed (sha256 as recorded), τ_fold re-measured, the heavy atoms of the two variants identical, E(opt) equal to the case optimisation.

## 30. Withdrawn facts and the rounding rule

Two final passes over all facts. (a) Withdrawn: the relax_iifix energies, structure metrics and proton metrics (H1A alone held in space; the lattice slid by 0.66 Å and N1 re-bonded to H1A, so the "constrained neutral" of burst 1 is a salt). Kept for provenance with value null, the number in withdrawn_value and status WITHDRAWN; numbers_audit.py therefore cannot match a printed number to them. Not cited. Only the three slide diagnostics (periodic.iifix_shift_mag, _shift_c, _N1_moved) stay citable, for a methodological note on why O5 must be held as well. (b) Rounding: every printed value is the full-precision value rounded half to even at its printed precision. Where a source stores a value already rounded to one digit beyond the printed precision and that digit is a 5 (a tie), the full-precision value re-derived from the same raw data replaces it (for the X-ray bonds: the full-precision .res coordinates, not the _atom_site coordinates rounded to their s.u.); the stored value stays in the note.

## 32. Periodic N1–H1A profile and the single-transfer control (VM burst 3)

d(N1–H1A) of both formula units held by a pw.x distance constraint at 1.10, 1.25, 1.40, 1.55 and 1.70 Å; H1A across the bond, O5 and every other atom free; fixed X-ray cell; PBE-D3(BJ)/SSSP, 70/560 Ry, 2×1×1; damped dynamics (pw.x accepts constraints only with damped or FIRE dynamics), converged on the constrained forces below 10⁻³ Ry Bohr⁻¹. Each point seeded by interpolating relaxed cell (i) towards the earlier constrained configuration. PBE0-D3(BJ) = the PBE-D3(BJ)/SSSP difference plus the hybrid correction from SG15 single points (100/400 Ry, q 1×1×1) at the same geometries, as for the single configuration of section 28. Slope dE/dd = (F_N1 − F_H1A)·u/2 per formula unit from the raw forces at the constrained minimum (u: N1→H1A): positive means the constraint holds H1A against a force back towards N1. Single-transfer control relax_iir1: relaxed cell (i) with H1A put 0.98 Å from O5 in formula unit 1 only, unconstrained BFGS without symmetry. Every number re-derived from the raw pw.x outputs (derive/d13_referee_calcs.py): final energies, final coordinates and cell, raw and constrained force blocks, pressures, the CONSTRAINTS card of each input.

## 33. Neutral IEF-PCM minimum: Hessian, thermochemistry and IR (VM burst 3)

sfa_pair_pcm_d3_oform: the O5-protonated minimum of the relaxed scan (chain B anchor, identical coordinates), finite-difference Hessian from 162 analytic gradients (step 0.005 Bohr), B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311++G(d,p), IEF-PCM (water), as for the salt (section 9). Differences neutral − salt are like for like: the same RRHO ideal-gas treatment on top of the PCM electronic energy, unscaled frequencies, no low-mode correction. Re-derived (derive/d13_referee_calcs.py): both Hessians re-diagonalised with translations and rotations projected out, IR intensities from the dipole derivatives, the proton stretch found by projection on N1–H1A and O5–H1A, and the thermochemistry of both minima recomputed with one code.

## 34. QTAIM of the nine crystal hydrogen bonds in a cluster cut from the periodic cells (VM burst 3)

Five ion pairs (135 atoms), the smallest connected set found by the cluster builder ("minimal" cover, build.json) that contains all nine CIF hydrogen bonds, eight of them at the central pair: N1–H1B···O6 occurs only between outer pairs (C1>A4 and C4>A2; the six-pair "central" cover with all nine at the central pair was not computed). Cut once from relaxed cell (i) (salt) and once from the constrained single configuration relax_iirfix (H1A held on O5 at 0.98 Å in every pair), every other atom at its periodic PBE-D3(BJ) position. B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-31+G(d,p) single points in the gas phase (PySCF, density fitting, grid 3), Multiwfn QTAIM of the whole cluster. The primary value of each bond is its instance at the central pair (for N1–H1B···O6 the primary instance C1>A4); where a bond occurs several times the spread over the instances shows the edge sensitivity. In the O5-protonated cluster the N1–H1A···O5 critical point is that of N1···H1A. Re-derived (derive/d13_referee_calcs.py): the raw CPprop.txt of both clusters parsed, each contact assigned to the (3,−1) point nearest its H···A segment by our own geometry, D···A of every contact compared with the cluster build.

## 35. Relaxed C3–C4–S1–N2 torsion scans (VM burst 3)

B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-311++G(d,p), IEF-PCM (water), grid 4: C3–C4–S1–N2 held at each value, everything else optimised (geomeTRIC), from 90° to 180° in 10° steps plus the torsions of the crystal ligands and of docked poses; sulfanilamide 22 points (one on the C5 branch as a mirror check), the sulfonamidate 18. Strain = E(constrained) − E(unconstrained minimum), the minimum re-optimised from the IEF-PCM optimum with the same settings (ref.json), electronic. Values off the computed points come from a cubic spline through the converged points and the minimum. This replaces the rigid single points of sections 29 and 31 (section 36). Re-derived (derive/d13_referee_calcs.py): every point energy re-read, τ_fold re-measured from each point geometry, the spline redone and evaluated at every docked seed of every production job.

## 36. Superseded facts (29 Sep 2026, after VM burst 3)

(a) Relabelled, still citable as what they are: the energies and geometry of relax_iirfix (sections 17 and 28, and the hybrid correction of section 28) describe one constrained configuration, O5–H1A held at 0.98 Å with H1A and O5 fixed; they are no longer the measure of the periodic cost, which is the constrained N1–H1A profile of section 32. (b) Retired, not cited: the rigid B3LYP-D3(BJ) single points of the docked poses (section 29) and their same-H references (section 31), replaced by the relaxed torsion scans of section 35 (the rigid values were dominated by the placement of the N–H hydrogens); and the order-of-magnitude estimates on relax_iirfix of section 31 (O–H relief, stress, their differences), replaced by the profile itself and by the stress estimate of section 32. ## 37. Measured hCA II binding of the controls, one "near-native" definition, raw-pose torsions

No new calculation. (a) PLBD (Lingė et al. 2023), the curated database of the Matulis laboratory, retrieved through its REST interface on 29 Sep 2026 (rows kept in paper/audit/research/plbd_hca2_azm_sfm.json, 10_Reproducibility/inputs/ of the data package; source notes in lit/SOURCE_NOTES.md): observed dissociation constants of hCA II from fluorescent thermal shift assays (table kd_obs_tsa_all_cas, column ca02, 37 °C; the experiments are those of Linkuvienė et al. 2018 at pH 7.0), and the intrinsic constants, from which PLBD has subtracted the protonation reactions of ligand and protein linked to binding (table intrinsic_parameters). (b) A docked mode is near-native when its symmetry-corrected heavy-atom RMSD to the crystal ligand is at most 1.0 Å (receptor frame); gap = score of the best-ranked near-native mode − score of the top mode (0 when the top mode is near-native); separation = |best near-native score − best score beyond 2.0 Å|. (c) τ_fold measured on the top pose of each seed as written by the docking program (out.pdbqt), heavy atoms only; strain from the spline of section 35.

## 38. Control receptor: the ATP site of E. coli DNA gyrase B (4DUH), not a target of sulfanilamide

Docked with the protocol of the five receptors of Section 2.5 (AutoDock Vina 1.2.7, Vina and Vinardo scoring, 20 Å cube on the centroid of the crystal ligand, exhaustiveness 32, 10 seeds; sulfanilamide species from their DFT geometries, every other ligand from one ETKDG/MMFF94s conformer per seed). The runs are kept out of gate G2 and of the production summary: the directories are named C1_*, and every number below comes from dock/control/control_summary.json (dock/control_gyrb.py analyse). A pose is "in the cavity of the inhibitor" when its heavy-atom centroid lies within 4.0 Å of a heavy atom of the crystal inhibitor (this says where a pose is, not that it is right); a crystal water is "overlapped" when its oxygen lies within 2.4 Å of a heavy atom of the pose. Scores are empirical docking scores, never affinities. No measurement says that sulfanilamide does not bind this pocket: the control is a receptor that is not a target, and the texts say so. Our parse of every out.pdbqt reproduces all 29 job means to 0.0004 kcal/mol and the redocking RMSDs to 0.0002 Å (derived/d15_control.json).

## 39. Review before submission (5 Oct 2026): 1-D proton model and its sensitivity, zero-point energy of the separated species, basis-set shift of the proton, measured absorption of sulfanilamide

The one-dimensional proton model of section 8 (dft/zpe_barrier.py) is rebuilt in derive/d16_jics.py: lower envelope of the two relaxed scan chains, PCHIP slopes set to zero at the two unconstrained minima, cubic Hermite interpolation in d(N1–H1A), harmonic walls beyond the scanned range, sinc-DVR on 801 points over the range plus 0.6 Å on each side, N–H reduced mass. With the stored wall constant on both sides it reproduces the stored level, its distance from the barrier top and the O5-side probability to 6e-07 (kcal mol⁻¹ and probability). The wall constant is the N1–H1A local-mode force constant of the salt; on the O5 side, where the relaxed coordinate beyond the neutral minimum is the soft N···O stretch, it has no physical basis, so that wall, the N1-side wall and the mass were varied (8 variants). The sign of the distance from the barrier top is not determined by the model; that the ground state lies mainly on the O5 side is. The other entries are differences of values of earlier sections, recomputed from the raw files, and one literature value.

## 40. Molecular dynamics of the carbonic anhydrase II–sulfanilamide complex and the two docking tests (Glu106, four crystal waters)

Molecular dynamics (md/RESULTS.md, record of 8 Oct 2026): hCA II of PDB 6RL9 with the sulfonamidate of sulfanilamide bonded to the zinc, nine runs of 100 ns with zinc set 2e (three from the crystal pose, start X; three from the docked near-native pose, start N; three from the docked ring-rotated pose, start R), two sensitivity runs of start R (R1_2s: the other zinc set; R1_n2fit: candidate terms at the sulfonamide nitrogen N2 that gate G-R2 did not accept) and two validation runs X0 of 5 ns. A frame is crystal-like if d1 < 6.7 Å and d2 > 5.2 Å, rotated-like if d1 > 6.7 Å and d2 < 5.2 Å, intermediate otherwise (d1: aniline N1 to Phe131 CZ; d2: N1 to Asn67 OD1); the verdict of a run reads its last 20 ns. Times "from the release" count from the start of equilibration stage 4, when the ligand is released; the production starts 1,300 ps later. derive/d17_md.py forms the series-based numbers again from md/results/series/ (state of every frame from d1 and d2; 0 frames classed differently from the analysis; means within 0.000001 Å), and the all-atom counts, gate G-Z and part A of gate G-R from the tracked files. It also compares 451 summary values with the second analysis program (largest difference 0.000000) and 220 values with the blind third reading (counts, verdicts and times equal; largest difference of a mean 0.00005 Å). Read from their source only, because git holds no per-frame data for them: the N–Zn–N angles, C4–S–N2, τ_fold, the temperature and density of the state logs, His64 and the water of the site, gates G-L, G-V (solute frames) and G-R2, and the quantum-chemical relaxation. The Zn–N distances of set 2e are put in by the parameter set (their equilibrium values are those of 6RL9) and are no result. Fractions of time are not populations, and no rate, barrier or free energy follows from these runs (md/PLAN.md, rule 5). Docking tests: every AutoDock4Zn, Vina and Vinardo run of dock/GLU106.md (Glu106 as the neutral acid, the state of the receptors of the paper, against Glu106 as a carboxylate) and of dock/WATER4.md (crystal waters 423, 516, 553 and 568 of 6RL9 kept as fixed receptor atoms). The runs with the waters are a diagnostic outside the protocol of the paper. Our parse of every out.pdbqt reproduces the 90 run records of the two tests: mean scores to 0.0000 kcal/mol, mean RMSDs to 0.0002 Å, and every count of seeds and modes (derived/d17_md.json). Near-native: a pose within 1.0 Å of the crystal ligand; rotated pose: beyond 2.0 Å from the crystal ligand and within 2.0 Å of the reference rotated pose (seed 14, mode 3 of the production run of the paper).
